name: Card
summary: A glass panel for one item; optionally one link that makes the whole card clickable.
rungReason: An <article> with its heading's link stretched over the card by a pseudo-element; no script, and the link keeps its name.

a11y.name: Its heading; the link's name is the heading's text

keyboard.action: Reaches the card's link, then any other controls in it

focus.indicator: The card shows the outline while its link has focus (:has(:focus-visible))

props.CardLink: the one main link, inside the heading

rules: One link per card: the stretched link covers everything but other links and buttons, which sit above it
The link's text is the heading, so its name is short; don't wrap the whole card in an <a>
Text in a linked card can't be selected by dragging: keep long text out of linked cards
